config.solver: spherical RK4, unit time per native sublayer, fixed native terminal-centered radius
config.numerics: 24 sketches and 24 gallery photos from Ext-1 without labels, seed 42. Each depth must pass. Choose the first substep count with target forward/reverse cycle median cosine >= .999, p01 >= .995 and p01 cosine against twice the resolution >= .995.
config.selection: Equal-weight full unseen Sketchy mAP, break ties by mean precision and then shallower depth. Evaluate TU only after the freeze. Two split Sketchy scores are exploratory.
config.success: At least +4 absolute mAP on each Sketchy split versus the paired Semantic Dot baseline, positive frozen transfer, and evidence for content-specific improvement over a shared shift.
controls: archived paired L4 Semantic Dot 601 reference
